αἰνῶς: αἰνῶς — terribly, exceedingly (of an uncanny likeness); adv. · also general intensifier with a verb of emotion: αἰνῶς ἵεται ’is terribly eager’
αἶψ: αἶψα — quickly, swiftly; adv., elided (αἶψ’ = αἶψα)
αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὐτὸς: αὐτός — self; masc. nom. sg.: ’himself’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a 1st-person subject: ’myself’ (ἐγὼν αὐτός) · also masc. nom. sg. with a 2nd-person subject: ’yourself’ (εἰδήσεις δὲ καὶ αὐτός ’you will see for yourself’)

αὖτ: αὖτε (elided αὖτ’) — again, in turn, moreover; epic adv./conj.
αὖτε: αὖτε — again, in turn, on the other hand; adv.
βίηφιν: βίη — force, might, violence; instrumental case in -φι(ν) (= dat. βίῃ): ’by force’
βλέφαρ: βλέφαρον (pl. βλέφαρα) — eyelid; neut. acc. pl., elided (βλέφαρ’ = βλέφαρα): ’eyelids’
βοήσας: βοάω — shout, cry out; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having shouted’
βουλή: βουλή — plan, counsel, will; nom. sg.
γ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle (elided γ’)
γέγωνε: γέγωνα (defective, akin to γεγωνέω) — be audible, make oneself heard; perf. 3 sg. with pres. force
γένοιτο: γίγνομαι — become, happen, turn out; aor. opt. 3 sg. (ὅπως ἄριστα γένοιτο ’how it might turn out best’) · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in a wish with μή: μὴ ... φίλον γένοιτο ’may it not prove pleasing’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in a wish after αἲ γάρ: αἲ γὰρ τοῦτο γένοιτο ’would that this might happen’
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
δαίμων: δαίμων — a god, some divine power (vague, unspecified); masc. nom. sg.
δείσαντες: δείδω — fear, dread; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having feared’
δι: διά — through; prep. + acc., elided (δι’ = διά): ’through (the night)’
διὰ: διά — through, throughout; prep. + acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: διὰ … τινάξῃ = διατινάξῃ ’shake apart, shatter’ · also + acc., causal, ’through, thanks to, by the aid of’ (διὰ … Ἀθήνην) · also as adverb/preverb in tmesis with κοσμηθέντες (διὰ … κοσμηθέντες = διακοσμηθέντες ’drawn up in divisions’) · also + gen., ’through, among’ (διὰ μήλων ’among the flocks’)
δόλῳ: δόλος — guile, trick, cunning; dat. sg.: ’by guile’
δόρυ: δόρυ — wood, tree-trunk, timber; also spear; neut. nom. sg.
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δῖαν: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; fem. acc. sg. δῖαν, here extended to the sea (ἅλα δῖαν ’the heavenly brine’) rather than a hero · also of a place-name: Λακεδαίμονα δῖαν ’heavenly Lacedaemon’ · also of Dawn: Ἠῶ δῖαν ’heavenly Dawn’
εἰ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. · also introducing an indirect question after a verb of asking or telling: ’whether’ (εἰ δή ’whether indeed’) · also in εἰ δ’ ἄγε, an interjectional idiom with the imperative: ’come now, well then’
εἰδώς: οἶδα — know; perf. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’knowing’
εἰν: ἐν (epic εἰν before a vowel) — in, on; + dat.
εἰπεῖν: εἶπον (aor. of φημί/λέγω, ’say, speak’) — say, tell; aor. inf. act., standing for an imperative: ’go and tell’
εἰπὼν: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
εἴ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. (accented εἴ before a following enclitic, περ among them) · also introducing an indirect question, ‘whether’ (τίς δ’ οἶδ’ εἴ κέ ... ‘who knows whether’)
εἴσβαινον: εἰσβαίνω — go aboard, embark; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= εἰσέβαινον)
εἶρος: εἶρος — wool; neut. acc. sg., epic form (= ἔριον)
εὔχεο: εὔχομαι — pray; pres. imper. 2 sg., uncontracted (= Attic εὔχου)
εὗδε: εὕδω — sleep; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’was sleeping, slept’
θάρσος: θάρσος — courage, boldness; neut. acc. sg.
θήλειαι: θῆλυς — female; adj., fem. nom. pl. (ἵπποι ... θήλειαι ’mares’)
θυμὸν: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; acc. sg.
θυμῷ: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; dat. sg.
θυράων: θύρα — door; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic θυρῶν)
θύραζε: θύραζε — to the outside, out of doors; adv., directional suffix -δε (= -ζε after a vowel)
θύρῃσι: θύρη — door; dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic θύραις; Ionic η for α)
κ: κε(ν) (elided κ’) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν)
κέ: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic
καθῖζον: καθίζω — sit down, take one’s seat; impf. 3 pl.
κακὸν: κακός — bad, evil; masc./neut. acc. sg.: ’by an evil (fate)’, inner acc. with μόρον · also neut. nom. sg., subject of an impersonal verb (τι … κακὸν … μελέτω ’let no evil thing be a care’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a plain substantive, direct object: ’harm, evil’ (κακὸν ἀλλοδαποῖσι φέροντες ’bringing harm to men of other lands’)
κακὸς: κακός — bad, base, cowardly; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’base’
κακῶν: κακός — bad, evil; neut. gen. pl.: ’of ills, of misfortunes’
καλλίτριχα: καλλίθριξ — fair-fleeced, with fine wool; neut. nom./acc. pl. (θ > τ before the aspirate of the stem: -τριχ-, ’fair-fleeced flocks’)
καρπαλίμως: καρπάλιμος — swift, nimble; adv. καρπαλίμως: ’swiftly, nimbly’
κατὰ: κατά — down, throughout, in; prep. + acc.; also as preverb in tmesis (κατὰ … ἤσθιον = κατήσθιον ’devoured’) · also ’according to, in conformity with’ (κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’) · also + acc., ’in quest of, after’ (κατὰ ληίδα ’in quest of plunder’) · also + gen., ’down from’ (κατὰ πετράων ’down from the rocks’) · also + gen., ’all over, throughout’ (κατὰ σπείους κέχυτο ’lay spread all over the cave’)
κεῖνος: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνος); masc. nom. sg.
κεῖτ: κεῖμαι — lie; impf. 3 sg., elided (κεῖτο → κεῖτ’ before a vowel): ’lay, was lying’
κλαίειν: κλαίω — weep, mourn; pres. inf.: ’to weep’
κληῖσι: κληΐς — thole-pin, oarlock (also ’key, bolt’ elsewhere); fem. dat. pl., epic -ισι · also ’rowing-bench, thwart’ (ἐπὶ κληῖσι καθῖζον ’sat down on the rowing-benches’)
κράτος: κράτος — strength, power, might; neut. nom. sg.
κρατερὸς: κρατερός — mighty, strong, powerful; masc. nom. sg.
κύκλωπα: Κύκλωψ — Cyclops, one of the one-eyed giants; masc. acc. sg.
κὰδ: κατά (apocope κάδ before δ-) — down through, throughout; prep./preverb in tmesis: ’throughout the halls’ (κὰδ δώματα = κατὰ δώματα) · also a bare preverb in tmesis with a verb: κὰδ ... ἔβαλε = κατέβαλε ’threw down’
κῆρ: κῆρ — heart; neut. acc. sg., accusative of respect (φίλον κῆρ ’in his own heart’) · also neut. nom. sg., subject of a verb: κῆρ ἤθελε ’my heart wished’
μ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (μ’ = με): ’me’ · also = dat. μοι, elided before a vowel, with a dat. participle: ’to me’ (ἥ μ’ οἴῳ ἔρροντι συνήντετο, συναντάω + dat.)
μέγ: μέγας — great; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, elided (μέγ’ = μέγα): ’greatly’ · also plain attributive adj. agreeing with a neut. noun, not adverbial: κῦμα μέγ’ ’a great wave’
μέγα: μέγας — great, huge; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’greatly’ (μέγα νήπιοι ’greatly foolish’)
μέγαν: μέγας — great, big, tall; masc. acc. sg.
μέλλεν: μέλλω — be about to, be destined to; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔμελλεν), + inf.: ’was on course to be’
μένος: μένος — force, might, spirit, drive; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject (μένος … ἐνέστακται ’his force has been instilled’)
μέσῳ: μέσος — middle, in the middle of; masc./neut. dat. sg., agreeing with πόντῳ: ’in the middle of the sea’
μή: μή — not; negative particle (used with imperatives and subjunctives, unlike οὐ) · also introducing a negative purpose/fear clause with the optative in secondary sequence: μή ἑ λάθοι ’lest he should escape notice’ · also μή + fut. inf. after a verb of swearing/promising, negating its content: μή ... βουλευσέμεν ’that ... will not plan’ · also ’lest’ with the subj. after a primary verb (μή πώς ... χαλεπήνῃ ’lest he be harsh’) · also in a question expecting the answer ’no’, after ἦ: ἦ μή … φάσθ’ ἔμμεναι; ’surely you do not say … are?’ · also ’lest’ + subj. after a past verb of urging (κελόμην … μή … λάθηται ’I urged … lest he forget’)
μήλων: μῆλον — sheep, small cattle; neut. gen. pl.
μακρὰ: μακρός — long, tall, high; neut. nom./acc. pl. (δούρατα μακρὰ ’long timbers’)
μεγάλ: μέγας — great, loud; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially, elided (μεγάλ’ = μεγάλα): ’loudly’ · also ’greatly, very’, strengthening ἤλιθα (μεγάλ’ ἤλιθα ’in huge abundance’)
μετ: μετά (elided μετ’) — among, after, in quest of; prep. + acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (μετ’ … βαῖνε = μετέβαινε ’followed’) · also + dat., ’among, between’ (μετ’ ἀμφοτέροισιν ’between the two of them’)
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’
μοχλὸν: μοχλός — stake, bar, lever; masc. acc. sg.
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
μῆλα: μῆλον — sheep, goat, flock-animal; neut. nom. pl.: ’the flocks’ · also neut. acc. pl. (same form), direct object: ἦγον ... μῆλα ’they led sheep’
μῆτιν: μῆτις — cunning intelligence, craft, counsel; fem. acc. sg.
μῆτις: μῆτις — cunning intelligence, craft, counsel; fem. nom. sg.
νήπιος: νήπιος — infant, still a child, witless; masc. nom. sg.
νωλεμέως: νωλεμέως — without a break, relentlessly, unyieldingly; adv.
νύκτα: νύξ — night; fem. acc. sg., accusative of duration: ’(through) the night’
νῆα: ναῦς — ship; acc. sg., epic νῆα
νῶτα: νῶτον — back; neut. acc. pl. νῶτα, poetic image ’the broad back(s) of the sea’ · also ’back’ of a person: ’his back’ (ἥ οἱ νῶτα … ἄμπεχεν)
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (very common) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό ’he, she, it’, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ (e.g. οἱ μὲν … οἱ δέ ’some … others’) · also encl. dat. sg. fem. ’to/for her’ (ἥ οἱ ὁμηλικίη ’who was of an age with her’)
οἳ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl.
οἴνῳ: οἶνος — wine; masc. dat. sg., instrumental: ’with wine’ (οἴνῳ βεβαρηότες ’heavy with wine’)
οἵ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl. · also encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (= οἱ, accented οἵ in this position) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; masc. nom. pl. ’they’, demonstrative: οἵ γ’ ὑβρισταί ’are they violent?’
οἶον: οἶος — alone, only; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with the subject: ’standing alone’ (ὅ τε φαίνεται οἶον ’which appears alone’)
οὐδὲ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὐτιδανὸς: οὐτιδανός — worthless, good-for-nothing; masc. nom. sg.
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
οὕτω: οὕτω(ς) — thus, so, in this way; adv.
οὖτις: Οὖτις — ’Nobody’, the name Odysseus gives himself (οὔ τις); masc. nom. sg.
πάντα: πᾶς — all, every; neut. nom./acc. pl. · also masc. acc. sg.: ’all’ (πάντα δῆμον ’all the people’)
πάντας: πᾶς — all, every; masc. acc. pl.
πάρος: πάρος — before, formerly; adv., with inf. like Attic πρίν · also a plain temporal adverb with a finite verb, not paired with an infinitive: ’formerly, in the past’ (αἳ πάρος ἦσαν ’who formerly were’)
πέμπε: πέμπω — send, send off; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’was sending’
πέτρη: πέτρη — rock, crag; fem. nom. sg.
πίονα: πίων — fat, rich; neut. acc. pl., agreeing with νῶτα: ’fat’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with οἶκον: ’rich’
πατρὶ: πατήρ — father; masc. dat. sg., governed by ὁμοῖοι ’like’ · also masc. dat. sg. of the person told: ’to (her) father’ (ἀγγείλειε ... πατρὶ φίλῳ ’report to her dear father’) · also masc. dat. sg. in apposition to Zeus: Διὶ πατρὶ ’to father Zeus’
περ: περ — even, though; concessive particle, esp. with a participle (= Attic καίπερ) · also used to intensify an adverb or pronoun rather than concede a point: ἔνθα περ ’in the very place where, just where’ · also after εἰ, ’if indeed, even if’: εἴ περ γάρ κεν ’if indeed ever’
περὶ: περί — around, about; prep. + gen.: ’superior to, beyond’; also as adv.: ’exceedingly, surpassingly’ · also prep. + gen. in its plain sense ’about, concerning’ (περὶ πατρός ’about his father’) · also preverb in tmesis · + dat. · also + acc., of place, ’around, about’ (περὶ ἄστυ ’around the city’) · also + gen., of place, physically ’around, encircling’ (περὶ σπείους γλαφυροῖο ’around the hollow cave’), distinct from the comparative ’beyond’ sense above · also + dat. in the fixed idiom περὶ κῆρι ’exceedingly, at heart’ (περὶ κῆρι τιμήσουσιν ’will honor him at heart’) · also + dat., of place, ’around, about’ (περὶ χροῒ ’about the skin’) · also adverb of place, no case: ’round about’ (περὶ δ’ ἕρκος ἐλήλαται ’and round it a fence is driven’)
πετάσσας: πετάννυμι — spread out; aor. part. masc. nom. sg., double σ metrical
ποίης: ποῖος — of what sort, what kind of; fem. gen. sg.
πολιὴν: πολιός — grey, hoary; adj., fem. acc. sg. (πολιὴν ἅλα ’the grey sea’)
πολλὰ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl.: ’many things, greatly’ · also neut. nom. pl., plain attributive adj. agreeing with a neut. pl. noun (πολλὰ ... δάκρυα ’many tears’) · also neut. acc. pl., plain attributive adj. (κτήματα πολλὰ ’many possessions’)
πολὺ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’by far’ · also neut. nom. sg. adj. agreeing with ὕδωρ: ’much, plentiful’
ποσειδάωνι: Ποσειδῶν — Poseidon; dat. sg., epic uncontracted
πού: πού — somewhere; enclitic adv., weakened to ’I suppose, perhaps’
προσέφη: πρόσφημι — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg.
προσηύδων: προσαυδάω — speak to, address; impf. 1 sg. (καί μιν ... προσηύδων ’I addressed him’)
πρὸς: πρός — towards, against, to; prep. + acc. · also a plain adverb, no case governed: ’besides, in addition’ · also + dat.: πρὸς ἀλλήλῃσιν ἔχονται ’cling close to one another’ · also + gen., ’from, under the protection of’ (πρὸς Διός εἰσιν ’are from Zeus’)
πτερόεντ: πτερόεις — winged, feathered; adj., neut. acc. pl., elided (πτερόεντ’ = πτερόεντα)
πυκινὰ: πυκινός — close-packed, thick, close; neut. acc. pl. (πυκινὰ πτερά ’close-packed wings’)
πως: πώς — somehow, in any way; enclitic adv. (οὔ πως ’in no way’)
πόλλ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl., elided (πόλλ’ = πολλά): ’many’ · also used adverbially: ‘much, often’ (πόλλ’ ἐπέεσσιν ‘again and again with words’)
πόρεν: πόρω — give, grant, furnish (defective, aor. only); aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἔπορεν)
πώ: πώ — yet, up to now; enclitic adv. (usually with a negative)
σ: σύ — you (sg.); encl. acc. sg., elided (σ’ = σε): ’you’
σκέπαρνον: σκέπαρνον — a woodworking tool for dressing timber, usually taken as an adze, though its exact shape is not certain; neut. acc. sg.
σμερδαλέον: σμερδαλέος — terrible, dreadful; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’terribly’
σπέος: σπέος — cave, grotto; neut. nom./acc. sg. (an irregular neuter noun declined σπέος, σπείους, etc.)
σπείους: σπέος — cave, grotto; neut. gen. sg., epic σπείους (= Attic σπέους)
στενάχοντες: στενάχω — groan, lament; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic (= στένω): ’groaning’
στενάχων: στενάχω — groan, moan; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
σὺν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat. · also as adverb, ’together’, or as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: σὺν … κάλυψε = συνεκάλυψε ’covered up’; σὺν … ἔπεσον = συνέπεσον ’fell together, clashed’
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a standing fact · after οὔ νυ perhaps τοι ’to you’ · also in a question, an expressive epic τε with no connective force, giving a note of doubt or wonder (πῶς τε ...; ’how, pray...?’) · also in ἦ τ’ (= ἦ τε), a strengthened affirmation: ’truly, surely’ (ἦ τ’ ἂν πολὺ κέρδιον ἦεν ’it would surely have been far better’)
τά: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl.; also relative: ’which’ (accented τά before a following enclitic)
τάχ: τάχα — soon, quickly, perhaps; adv., elided (τάχ’ = τάχα)
τί: τίς, τί — who? what?; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially ’why’ · also the enclitic indefinite τις, τι ’someone, something’ (accented τί before an enclitic): neut. acc. sg. used adverbially with a negative, ’at all’ (οὔ τι) · adj. · also plain interrogative, direct object/predicate: ’what’ (τί πάθω ’what am I to suffer’; τί ... γένηται ’what is to become’) · also the enclitic indefinite as an adjective agreeing with a noun, accented before enclitic που: εἴ τί που εἴλυμα ’if any wrapper’ · also enclitic indefinite with a negative, ’anything’, as accusative subject of an infinitive (οὐ … τί φημι κακώτερον ἄλλο … συγχεῦαι ’I say nothing else is worse’) · also enclitic indefinite, adverbial without a negative: ’somehow, in some way’ (τοῦτό τί μοι κάλλιστον ’this seems to me somehow the fairest’)
τίπτε: τίπτε — why ever, what then (= τί ποτε shortened); interrog. adv.
τίς: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc. nom. sg. · also the enclitic indefinite τις accented before a following enclitic, not interrogative: ’someone, anyone’ (ἤν τίς τοι εἴπῃσι ’if someone tells you’)
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τετληότι: τλάω — endure, have the heart to bear; perf. part. (τετληώς) masc./neut. dat. sg.: ’enduring’
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., used adverbially with negatives ’at all’ · also adjectival indefinite: ’some, any’ (τι δήμιον ἄλλο ’some other public matter’) · also adverbial without a negative: ’in some way, in some measure’ (τι κατὰ πρῆξιν ’on some business’) · also as a substantive object, in a question: ’anything, something’ (ἦ ῥά τι ἴδμεν ’do we know anything’) · also the neut. of τις forming, with a preceding ὅ, the indefinite relative ὅ τι ’whatever, that which’ (αὔδα ὅ τι φρονέεις ’say whatever you have in mind’) · also ὅ τι as an adverbial acc. in an indirect question: ’why’
τιν: τις, τι — someone, something; neut./masc. acc. sg., elided (τιν’ = τινα)
τινά: τις, τι — someone, something; masc. acc. sg., indefinite, accented before enclitic οἱ (with ὅν: ὅν τινα ’whatever’) · also neut. acc. pl., ’any’, with an understood noun (εἴ τινά που δεδάηκας ’if you have learned any’)
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg.
τοὺς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. pl. (ἀέθλους, τοὺς … ἐπειρήσαντο Ὀδυσῆος ’the contests with which they tried Odysseus’) · also demonstrative with a noun: masc. acc. pl. ’those, the’ (τοὺς ἄλλους … ἑταίρους ’the rest of my companions’)
τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. gen. sg. ’of him, that one’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whose, of whom; masc. gen. sg. (τοῦ νῶι θεοῦ ὣς τερπόμεθ’ αὐδῇ ’whose voice we delight in’) · also demonstrative gen. of comparison after a comparative: τοῦ γε κρεῖσσον ’better than this’ · also neut. gen. sg. in ἐκ τοῦ: ’from that time’ · also neut. gen. sg., partitive, ’of it’ (τοῦ μὲν ὅσον τ’ ὄργυιαν ’of it, about a fathom’)
τρεῖς: τρεῖς — three; numeral, masc./fem. nom. pl. · also masc./fem. acc. pl. (same syncretic form): ’three’ (ἑταίρους τρεῖς ’three companions’, acc.)
τόσον: τόσος — so much, so great; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially
τόσσον: τόσος (epic τόσσος) — so much, so great; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’so much’
τότ: τότε — then, at that time; adv., elided (τότ’ = τότε)
τότε: τότε — then, at that time; adv.
τὰ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’ · also in the adverbial idiom τὰ πρῶτα, ’at first, first’ (not ’these things’) · also with a noun, pointing to it: ’those, the’ (τὰ σὰ γούνατα ’those knees of yours’)
τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg. (τὸ πάροιθεν ’that which was before’) · also with a noun, pointing to it: ’that, the’ (τὸ σῆμα ’that mark’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. sg. (τὸν Ἀλφειὸς τέκε ’whom Alpheus begot’) · also demonstrative adjective with a noun: ’that, the’ (τὸν μῦθον ’that story, message’)
τὼ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. dual: ’the two of them’  ·  also acc. dual, object of a verb of address: τὼ … προσέφη ’spoke to the two of them’ · also relative, nom. dual, ’who (the two)’: τοκῆε δύω, τὼ μὴ γείνασθαι ὄφελλον
τῇς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. dat. pl., epic τῇς (= Attic ταῖς): ’to/among them’
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc./neut. dat. sg.; also relative: ’in which’ · the relative dat. sg. also serves as an instrumental, ’with which’ (τῷ δάμνησι ’with which she overpowers’) · also adverbial ’therefore, and so’ (τῷ οὔ τινα οἶδα ’so I know no one’) · also article-like with a noun: ’that, the same’ (ἤματι τῷ αὐτῷ ’on that same day’)
φάνη: φαίνω — show; aor. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐφάνη): ’appeared’
φέρον: φέρω — carry, bear; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἔφερον): ’used to bear’ · also ’carried, were carrying’ (φέρον ἐσθῆτα ’they carried the clothes’) · also impf. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἔφερον): ’I carried, I was carrying’
φίλοι: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. nom. pl.: ’dear (guest-friends)’ · also masc. voc. pl. (identical form), direct address: ’friends!’ (δεῦτε, φίλοι) · also attributive, with a noun: φίλοι υἷες ’dear sons’
φίλον: φίλος — dear, one’s own (with kin/body parts serves as a possessive); neut. nom./acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masculine noun: φίλον υἱόν ’dear son’ · also masc. acc. sg. predicative, agreeing with a pronoun: ’as a friend, welcome’ (φίλον ἐλθεῖν)
φαίνετο: φαίνω — show; mid. appear, seem; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐφαίνετο)
φημι: φημί — say, declare, assert; pres. 1 sg.
φρένας: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. acc. pl.
φρεσὶ: φρήν — mind, heart, wits; fem. dat. pl.
φρονέοντι: φρονέω — think, consider; pres. part. dat. sg. masc., agreeing with οἱ: ’to him as he considered’
φύγομεν: φεύγω — flee, escape; aor. 1 pl., unaugmented (= ἐφύγομεν): ’we escaped’
χαλκεὺς: χαλκεύς — smith, bronze-worker; masc. nom. sg.
χερσὶ: χείρ — hand; fem. dat. pl., epic -σί (= Attic χερσίν)
χεῖρε: χείρ — hand; fem. acc. dual: ’his two hands’
ἀέκοντος: ἄκων (ἀέκων) — unwilling; masc. gen. sg., idiom βίῃ ἀέκοντος ’by force, against one’s will’ (gen. loosely agreeing with the person referred to)
ἀγόρευον: ἀγορεύω — speak, say, declare; impf. 3 pl.
ἀθεμίστια: ἀθεμίστιος (= ἀθέμιστος) — lawless, without regard for right (ἀ- + θέμις); neut. acc. pl., as noun: ’lawless things’
ἀλέασθαι: ἀλέομαι (ἀλεύομαι) — avoid, shun; aor. inf. mid. ἀλέασθαι (Attic φυγεῖν, ἐκκλίνειν)
ἀμβροσίην: ἀμβροσίη — ambrosia, the fragrant food/substance of the gods; fem. acc. sg.
ἀμφὶ: ἀμφί — on both sides, around, about; prep./adv. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφὶ ... βάλλομεν = ἀμφιβάλλομεν ’we threw around, embraced’)
ἀμφὶς: ἀμφίς — apart, on both sides, around; adverb
ἀμύμων: ἀμύμων — blameless, excellent (an old epithet whose exact force is uncertain); masc./fem. nom. sg.
ἀνὰ: ἀνά — up along, throughout; prep. + acc. · also as preverb in tmesis (ἀνὰ … κέρασσεν, from ἀνακεράννυμι ’mix up’) · also + gen., ’up onto’ (ἀνὰ νηὸς ἔβην ’I went up on board’) · also + acc., proportional, ’to, at the rate of’ (ἀνὰ εἴκοσι μέτρα ’at twenty measures (of water) to the one cup’)
ἀπεσσύμεθ: ἀποσεύομαι — rush away, dart off; aor. mid. 1 pl., augmented, elided (ἀπεσσύμεθ’ = ἀπεσσύμεθα), doubled σσ (Attic ἀπεσύμεθα)
ἀπονέεσθαι: ἀπονέομαι — go back, return; pres. inf.
ἀπὸ: ἀπό — from, away from; + gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει ’will destroy’; ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη ’be given back’)
ἀπῆν: ἄπειμι — be away, be distant; impf. 3 sg.
ἀρίστη: ἄριστος — best; superl., fem. nom. sg.
ἀρημένος: ἀρημένος — worn down, distressed, oppressed; Homeric participle shaped like a perf. pass., masc. nom. sg.; verb and derivation uncertain (perh. tied to ἀρή ’harm’)
ἁλμυρὸν: ἁλμυρός — briny, salty; adj., neut. acc. sg. (agreeing with ὕδωρ)
ἁπάντων: ἅπας — all, the whole of; neut. gen. pl.: ’of all (ills)’ · also masc. gen. pl., in comparison: ’of all (mortals)’ · also gen. pl. with a noun: ’of all (men)’
ἄλλοθεν: ἄλλοθεν — from elsewhere, from another place; adv. (ἄλλος + -θεν ’from’)
ἄλλος: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. sg.
ἄλλυδις: ἄλλυδις — in one direction, elsewhere; adv. (ἄλλυδις ἄλλη ’each a different way’)
ἄλλῃ: ἄλλος — other, another; fem. dat. sg. used adverbially: ’elsewhere’ · also fem. dat. sg. adjective, ’(at) another (woman)’ (ἄλλῃ νεμεσῶ)
ἄνακτι: ἄναξ — lord, king, master; masc. dat. sg.
ἄνακτος: ἄναξ — lord, king, master; masc. gen. sg.
ἄναξ: ἄναξ — lord, master; masc. nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form), in address: ’lord!’ (κλῦθι, ἄναξ ’hear me, lord’)
ἄνθεα: ἄνθος — flower, blossom; neut. nom. pl., uncontracted (= Attic ἄνθη)
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, elided form ἄρ’ before a vowel · also the shortened form ἄρ used, without true elision, before τε in the fixed collocation ἄρ τε: τὰ μὲν ἄρ τε διεσκέδασ’
ἄριστα: ἀγαθός (superl. ἄριστος) — best; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’best’ (ὄχ’ ἄριστα ’far the best’)
ἄριστος: ἀγαθός — good; superlative ἄριστος ’best’; adj., masc. nom. sg.
ἄρσενα: ἄρσην — male; neut. acc. pl., used substantivally: ’the males’ (Attic ἄρρην, ἄρρενα)
ἅλα: ἅλς — sea, salt sea; fem. acc. sg.
ἆσσον: ἆσσον — nearer, closer; adv., comparative of ἄγχι
ἐβόησας: βοάω — shout, cry out; aor. 2 sg., augmented: ’you cried out’
ἐγώ: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg. (accented ἐγώ before the enclitic τοι that follows)
ἐγὼν: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg., form used before a vowel
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐλάινον: ἐλάϊνος — of olive-wood (ἐλαία); masc./neut. acc. sg.
ἐλαύνομεν: ἐλαύνω — drive, row, march; pres.-stem form with past narrative force, 1 pl.: ’we rowed on’
ἐλθόντες: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having come’
ἐμείναμεν: μένω — stay, wait, wait for; aor. 1 pl.
ἐμοὶ: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg.: ’to, for me’
ἐμὸν: ἐμός — my, mine; masc./neut. acc. sg.
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνόησεν: νοέω — perceive, devise, think of; aor. 3 sg.
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’)
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’)
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐπ’ … χεῦε = ἐπέχευε ‘poured upon’)
ἐπιμασσάμενος: ἐπιμαίομαι — feel over, grope at; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., epic σσ: ’having felt out’
ἐπιπλεῖν: ἐπιπλέω — sail over, sail upon (+ acc.); pres. inf.
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as adverb, no case expressed: ’to it, over it; besides’ (θεοὶ δ’ ἐπὶ μάρτυροι ’witnesses to it’; ἐπὶ κτέρεα κτερεΐξαι ’besides’) · also + dat., ’beyond, over and above, more than’ (ἐπὶ γαστέρι κύντερον ’more shameless than the belly’)
ἐρετμοῖς: ἐρετμόν — oar; neut. dat. pl., instrumental: ’with oars’
ἐστίν: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., ν-movable form
ἐόντα: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc./neut. acc. sg., epic (= Attic ὄντα)
ἐών: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic ἐών (= Attic ὤν), accented ἐών before a pause: ’being’ (τοῖος ἐών ’being such’)
ἑ: ἕ — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. sg. reflexive/personal pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/-ήν/-ό)
ἑζόμενοι: ἕζομαι — sit down; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’seated’
ἑκάστῳ: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. dat. sg.
ἑλόντες: αἱρέω — take, capture; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having taken’
ἑξῆς: ἑξῆς — in order, one after another; adv. (by-form of ἑξείης)
ἑσπέριος: ἑσπέριος — of evening, at evening; masc. nom. sg. used adverbially: ’in the evening’
ἑτάροισι: ἕταρος — companion (by-form of ἑταῖρος); dat. pl., epic -οισι
ἑταίρους: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. acc. pl.
ἑταῖροι: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. nom. pl.
ἔην: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἦν)
ἔπεα: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔπη)
ἔπειτ: ἔπειτα (elided ἔπειτ’) — then, next, after that
ἔπεσσι: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic ἔπεσι)
ἔπι: ἐπί — on, upon, over; prep. + dat., placed after its noun with anastrophe: ἑοῖς ἔπι ’upon his own (possessions)’ · also + gen., postpositive with anastrophe, of direction: ’toward’ (νήσου ἔπι Ψυρίης ’toward the island of Psyria’) · also as adverb with no case expressed, intensifying repetition: ’besides, again’ (ἔπι δεύτερον αὖτις ’a second time, once more’) · also = ἔπεστι, accented on the first syllable when it stands for the verb: ’there is (upon)’
ἔστι: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg. impersonal: ’it is possible’ · also existential, ‘there is’ (ἔστι δέ τις πέτρη ‘there is a rock’)
ἔχοντες: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
ἕκαστον: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. acc. sg.
ἕο: reflexive pron. (= ἑαυτοῦ, Attic οὗ) — himself; gen. sg. · also referring back to a feminine subject: ’of herself, of it’ (ἐκέλευσεν ἕο μνήσασθαι, of the belly, ’bids one think of it’)
ἠριγένεια: ἠριγένεια — early-born; fem. nom. sg., epithet of Dawn
ἠώς: ἠώς — dawn; fem. nom. sg. (personified Ἠώς, Attic Ἕως)
ἠὲ: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ)
ἠῶ: ἠώς (Attic ἕως) — dawn; acc. sg., accusative of extent: ’on into the dawn’ · also acc. after πρός: ’towards the dawn, the east’ (πρὸς ἠῶ) · also direct object of a verb of waiting: ’(waited for) Dawn’ (ἐμείναμεν Ἠῶ δῖαν)
ἡμεῖς: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; nom. pl. ’we’
ἥδε: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., fem. nom. sg.
ἦ: ἦ — truly, verily; affirming particle · also interrogative particle introducing an earnest question · also = ἤ ’or’, in the correlative ἠέ … ἦ ’whether … or’ · also ἠμί — say, speak; unaugmented aor./impf. 3 sg. (= ἔφη), closing or introducing direct speech: ’he/she said’ (ἦ ῥα ’so he said’)
ἦεν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἦν)
ἦμος: ἦμος — when, at the time when; temporal conj.
ἧος: ἧος — as long as, while; temporal conj., epic (= Attic ἕως) · also ’until’, and by extension ’so that’, introducing a purpose clause with the optative after a past main verb (ἧος … παύσειε ’so that it might stop her weeping’) · also plain temporal ’until’, with the indicative marking a definite past terminus: ἧος ... κατέπεφνεν ’until Artemis slew him’
ἰοδνεφὲς: ἰοδνεφής — violet-dark, dusky violet (ἴον + δνόφος); adj., neut. acc. sg.; exact shade uncertain
ἱκόμεθ: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive; aor. mid. 1 pl., unaugmented, elided (ἱκόμεθ’ = ἱκόμεθα): ’we have come’
ἱμάντι: ἱμάς — strap, thong; masc. dat. sg.
ἴαχε: ἰάχω — cry out, resound, roar; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, of a loud natural noise
ἵσταντ: ἵστημι — set, stand; impf. 3 pl. mid., elided (ἵσταντ’ = ἵσταντο): ’took their stand’
ὀίων: ὄϊς — sheep; masc./fem. gen. pl., epic (= Attic οἰῶν)
ὀφρύσι: ὀφρύς — eyebrow, brow; fem. dat. pl., epic -υσι (= Attic -ύσι)
ὁ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. sg.
ὃν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (masc. acc. sg.)
ὄλεθρον: ὄλεθρος — destruction, ruin, death; acc. sg.
ὄνομ: ὄνομα — name; neut. nom. sg., elided (ὄνομ’ = ὄνομα), subject of λίπηται: ’his name’
ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἔτι κεῖνος ἀνὴρ ἐπιδήμιος ἦεν ’as long as that man was still at home’) · also ’while’ + ἄν and subj. · also temporal ’until’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἵκετ’ Ἀρήτην ’until he came to Arete’) · also ’until’ + ἄν and subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν ἵκηαι ’until you reach’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a secondary verb: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρ’ … μένοιεν)
ὄχ: ὄχα — by far, exceedingly; adv., elided (ὄχ’ = ὄχα), intensifying a superlative (ὄχ’ ἄριστα ’far the best’)
ὅππῃ: ὅππῃ — in whatever way, wherever; epic relative adv. (= Attic ὅπῃ)
ὅπως: ὅπως — so that, in order that, how; + subj. or fut. indic. · also + opt., in secondary sequence after a past-tense verb, indirect deliberative: ’how it might’ (ὅπως ἄριστα γένοιτο ’how it might turn out best’) · also ’when’ = ὅτε · also ’as, however’ + subj. in a general clause: ὅπως ἐθέλῃσιν ’however he wishes’ · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might follow’ (ὅπως … ἑποίατο)
ὅσσον: ὅσος (epic ὅσσος) — as much/great as; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, correlative with τόσσον: ’as far as’ · also in an indirect exclamation, ’how greatly’ (ὅσσον ἄρισται ’how excellent they are’)
ὅτ: ὅτε (elided ὅτ’) — when; temporal conj., here + ἄν and subj. in a general/future clause · also + indic., of a single definite past event: ’when’ (ὅτ’ ἐν Ἄργεϊ ... ἵστασαν ’when they were mooring in Argos’) · also + opt., in a repeated past clause: ’whenever’ (ὅτ’ ἂψ ἄρχοιτο ’whenever he began again’) · also + subj. without ἄν, in a general clause: ὅτ’ … ἔχῃ ’whenever … holds’
ὅτε: ὅτε — when; temporal conjunction · also ’since, now that’ (ὅτε πρότερός γε πύθοιτο ’since he learned of it first’) · also with the optative, hypothetical/conditional: ’if ever, whenever’ (ὅτε ... ἵκοι ’if ever such need should come upon me’) · also with the subjunctive, general: ’whenever’ (ὅτε στείχῃσ’ ἀνὰ ἄστυ ’whenever she goes through the town’)
ὅττι: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; epic neut. nom./acc. sg. ὅττι (= Attic ὅ τι) · also with a superlative, ’as … as possible’ (ὅττι τάχιστα ’as quickly as possible’)
ὑπ: ὑπό (elided ὑπ’) — under, beneath; prep. + gen.; also + acc., ’under, up under’ · also of agent with a verb of dying, ‘by, at the hands of’ + gen. (ὤλεθ’ ὑπ’ Αἰγίσθοιο ‘perished by Aegisthus’) · also + dat., ’under, beneath’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb, no case governed: οὓς ὑπ’ Ὀδυσσεὺς δύσετ’ = ὑπεδύσετο ’underneath which Odysseus sank down’
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; prep. + dat./acc.; also used as an adverb, ’beneath’ · also as preverb in tmesis (ὑπὸ … ἐδήσατο = ὑπεδήσατο ’bound beneath’) · also adverbial, of breeding: ’begotten under, born of’ (ὑπὸ δ’ ἡμίονοι ’and under them [the mares], mules’) · also + dat., marking the agent with a passive verb: ’by’ (ὑπὸ μνηστῆρσιν δαμείη ’be overcome by the suitors’) · also + gen., ’from under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο) · also + gen., marking agent with a passive verb/participle beyond dying, ’by’: μεγάλου ὑπὸ κύματος ἀρθείς ’lifted up by a great wave’ · also + gen., of cause: ὑπὸ ῥιπῆς ’at the rush (of the throw)’
ὕδωρ: ὕδωρ — water; neut. acc. sg. · also nom. sg. (identical neut. form), subject of a verb (ἄνεμός τε καὶ ὕδωρ ‘wind and current’)
ὕφαινον: ὑφαίνω — weave, hence devise, contrive; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’were weaving, were devising’
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that, when; with the optative introduces a wish: ’so may…’ (unaccented; accented ὥς / ὣς is ’thus’) · also ὡς + unaugmented ὄφελον + inf., an unfulfillable wish: ’would that...’ · also ὡς + opt., a purpose clause (= ἵνα): ’so that’ (ὡς τὸν χόλον ἐξακέσαιτο ’so that he might appease the anger’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. + inf.: ’how (good, etc.) it is to...’ (ὡς ἀγαθὸν ... λιπέσθαι ’how good a thing it is to be left behind’) · also plain ὡς + indic., ’as’ (ὡς σὺ κελεύεις ’as you command’) or ’how’ in an indirect question (ὡς ἐπὶ πόντον ἐλεύσομαι ’how I shall come upon the sea’) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν μὴ κλαίουσα κατὰ χρόα καλὸν ἰάπτῃς ’so that you might not mar your fair skin with weeping’) · also ὡς δ’ ὅτε introducing an epic simile, ’as when’, its clause taking indic. or ἄν/κε + subj. for a general case: ὡς δ’ ὅτ’ ἂν ... φανήῃ ’as when ... should appear’ · also comparative ’like’, placed after the noun it compares (ἀνέμου ὡς πνοιή ’like a blast of wind’) · also ὡς εἰ ’as if, like’ (ὡς εἰ πτερὸν ἠὲ νόημα ’as if a wing or a thought’) · also ὡς + ἄν + opt., potential, ’as, in the way that, such as’ (ὡς οὐκ ἂν ἔλποιο ’such as you would not expect’) · also introducing a simile with the subj. and no ἄν: ’as when (a woman weeps)’
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως) · also postpositive after its noun (anastrophe), = comparative ὡς ’as, like’: ὄρνις δ’ ὥς ’like a bird’
ὥς: ὥς — thus, so; also (with κε/ἄν + subj.) ’so that, in order that’; adverb/conjunction · also introducing an indirect question: ’how’ (ὥς κε νέηται ’how he is to return’, after φράσσεται) · or ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic τε · also causal, ’since, seeing that’ (ὥς οἱ ἐναργὲς ὄνειρον ἐπέσσυτο ’since a vivid dream had come upon her’) · also with κεν + opt., purpose: ’so that’ (ὥς κεν … γένοιτο ’so that he might become’) · also ὥς ’just as’, in ὥς περ (accented before enclitic περ) (ὥς περ ὑπέστης ’just as you promised’)
ὧδ: ὧδε — so, thus, in this way; adv., elided (ὧδ’ = ὧδε)
ὧδε: ὧδε — here, to this place, in this way; adv.
ᾕρει: αἱρέω — take, seize; impf. 3 sg., augmented: ’seized’
ῥά: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, weak enclitic form ῥα, accented ῥά
ῥοδοδάκτυλος: ῥοδοδάκτυλος — rose-fingered; fem. nom. sg., epithet of Dawn
